snapDescription: A Farcaster snap server with templates for guides, multi-page tutorials, polls, quizzes, and token interactions. Interactive snaps store responses per user in SQLite, preserving votes and answers when people return and showing live results. Such Snap won a hackathon award leading up to FarCon Rome.
